module: Screen-space ambient occlusion (SSAO, with bent normals / GTAO). On import, creates the object "SSAOPostFx" (PostEffectSSAO) if missing, then sets its bentNormals property from the PostFXSpecularOcclusionEnabled setting, and creates "SSAOVizPostFx" to visualize #ssaoMask. The module keeps the current contrast and radius in memory and passes them to the object.
usage:
local ssao = require('client/postFx/ssao')
ssao.setRadius(2.0)
ssao.setContrast(1.5)
print(ssao.getRadius(), ssao.getContrast())
notes: Default values: contrast 2, radius 1.5 (variables defaultContrast / defaultRadius).
setContrast and setRadius apply tonumber; a non-numeric value is ignored without error.

setContrast.desc: Stores the SSAO contrast and applies it to SSAOPostFx (the object's setContrast method). Ignored if the value cannot be converted to a number.

setRadius.desc: Stores the SSAO radius and applies it to SSAOPostFx. Ignored if the value is not numeric.

value.desc: New radius (scene unit, inferred from code).

applyDefaults.desc: Sets $SSAOPostFx::Enable to true and restores the default contrast (2) and radius (1.5).

setBentNormalDebugEnabled.desc: Enables or disables a debug effect (GTAOBentNormalsVizPostFx, created on demand) that displays the bent normals map #gtaoOutput. No cost while it is disabled.

enabled.desc: true to show, false to hide.
